excerpt: A frontier developer should make a strong argument that: No user or team of users (including those backed by top-tier states) will become significantly more likely to cause catastrophic harm via their usage of product surfaces or via theft of model weights.
paraphrase: Developers should argue no user or team, even state-backed, becomes significantly more capable of catastrophic harm via product use or weight theft.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: This will likely require similar measures to those listed in row 1, but to a higher standard‚ to the point where even well-resourced and -staffed threat actors would be unlikely to reliably jailbreak models or cause catastrophic harm via unauthorized access to or modification of models (including via stolen or modified model weights).
paraphrase: Similar measures to row 1 are needed but at a higher standard to resist well-resourced threat actors from jailbreaking or misusing models.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations

excerpt: Accomplishing this would likely mean security roughly in line with RAND SL4.
paraphrase: This would likely require security roughly at RAND SL4 level.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: Security requirements would be calibrated to defend against the strongest plausible threat actors who are not bound by a credible industry-wide safety regime.
paraphrase: Security requirements should be set against the strongest plausible unbound threat actors.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: Actors subject to such a regime would not need to be treated as threats to each other's model weights.
paraphrase: Actors bound by a credible regime wouldn't need to be treated as threats to one another's model weights.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: Even malicious employees and other insiders with maximal levels of access will not be significantly enabled to cause catastrophic harm.
paraphrase: Even maximally-privileged malicious insiders should not be significantly enabled to cause catastrophic harm.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: This requires (among other things) accounting for internal tools that are less restricted than product surfaces, and for the possibility of unauthorized modification of models.
paraphrase: This requires accounting for less-restricted internal tools and the possibility of unauthorized model modification.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: This will likely require an internal Usage Policy and strong internal compartmentalization, controls and/or monitoring to restrict the ability of employees and contractors (up to and including the company's CEO as well as its most privileged technical employees) to circumvent the Usage Policy.
paraphrase: This likely requires an internal Usage Policy plus strong compartmentalization/controls to prevent even the CEO or most privileged staff from circumventing it.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: AI models have not been deliberately or inadvertently trained with dangerous goals, or are otherwise unlikely to autonomously cause catastrophic harm.
paraphrase: Models should not have been trained—deliberately or inadvertently—with dangerous goals, or otherwise be unlikely to autonomously cause catastrophic harm.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: This will likely require similar measures to those listed above under "Misaligned AI systems in high-stakes settings" (some combination of internal compartmentalization, restriction and code review; monitoring AI behavior; and evidence that AI models lack the propensity to deceive and manipulate users), but to a greater degree.
paraphrase: Similar measures as the misaligned AI systems row are likely needed, but to a greater degree.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains. Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations.
excerpt: In particular, at this point AI systems might be responsible for much of the research and analysis that underpins risk assessment, and might have strong capabilities for deception, manipulation and obfuscation of evidence, in which case analyses of threats from AIs should follow very high evidentiary standards with thorough and careful analysis of the possibility that much of the key evidence is suspect due to the possibility of manipulation by AI systems.
paraphrase: Since AI may conduct much of the underlying risk research and could deceive or obfuscate evidence, threat analyses should apply very high evidentiary standards accounting for possible AI manipulation of evidence.

excerpt: We will maintain a Frontier Safety Roadmap laying out ambitious but achievable goals for improving our risk mitigations—charting our progress as a company and raising the bar over time.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain a Frontier Safety Roadmap with ambitious achievable goals to improve mitigations and track progress over time.

excerpt: Maintaining and reporting on this Roadmap is part of our work under the RSP.
paraphrase: Maintaining and reporting the Roadmap is part of the RSP's obligations.

excerpt: It will be shared with all full-time employees as well as our Board of Directors (Board) and Long-Term Benefit Trust (LTBT), and published in redacted form.
paraphrase: The Roadmap will be shared with all full-time employees, the Board, and the LTBT, and published in redacted form.

excerpt: We will provide updates on whether we achieve the goals, and set new goals when we do.
paraphrase: Anthropic will report on goal achievement and set new goals accordingly.
